title: I.O.U.S.A.: Byte-Sized - The 30 Minute Version
summary: A 30-minute condensed version of the documentary I.O.U.S.A., which examines the growing US national debt and its consequences.
why: Shared as a quick way to see the film's fiscal warnings, sometimes as an example of ignored warnings.

quote.text: Here is a bite sized 30 min version of a movie called IOUSA that outlines the major problems that are ahead
